title: Cohomological lower bound for pro-etale internal Hom
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and R an arbitrary commutative ring sheaf. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. If K is in D^{≤b} and M in D^{≥N} for integers b,N in the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], then Rℋom_R(K,M) is in D^{≥N-b}. No constructibility, Noetherian, rational-coefficient or dimension hypothesis is required.

proof.text: The independent-universe module category is Grothendieck by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Choose a representative L of K vanishing above b and a representative P of M vanishing below N using [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Resolve P by injectives with the same bound N using Mathlib CochainComplex.Plus.modelCategoryQuillen.exists_quasiIso_injective, the cochain version of [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. The resulting I is K-injective. The independent-universe comparison of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] identifies Rℋom(K,M) with Q Hom(L,I).

The product projections [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections] identify the degree n term with the product of Hom(L^p,I^{p+n}). For n<N-b, either p>b, so L^p=0, or p≤b, so p+n<N and I^{p+n}=0. The defining sectionwise pre/postcomposition formula shows internal Hom with a zero source or target is zero. A product of zero objects is zero. Thus the Hom complex vanishes below N-b, and transport through its representative isomorphism gives the desired cohomological bound.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_internalHom_isGE (T : Scheme.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R))]
    (K M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology T)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)))
    (b N : ℤ) [K.IsLE b] [M.IsGE N] :
    ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology T) R).obj (op K, M)).IsGE (N - b)
